eligibility: Age at least 18 years. Histologically confirmed sinonasal carcinoma treated by endoscopic endonasal surgery with histosurgical mapping in the 2 months before radiotherapy, and an indication for adjuvant radiotherapy without neoadjuvant chemotherapy.
Affiliated with a social security system and able to consent.
Excluded: more than 8 weeks between surgery and radiotherapy, and histologies other than carcinoma, including melanoma, sarcoma, and lymphoma. Pregnancy is excluded.

pretreatment.note: Planning CT simulation. Radiotherapy starts no earlier than 4 weeks and no later than 8 weeks after surgery.

during.window: Five days per week, about 7 weeks
during.note: Daily online image guidance. Multi-field optimization is used when single-field uniform dose does not cover the target and spare organs. At the proton center, linear-energy-transfer-averaged plans are used for robustness when needed. The first four plans have prospective individual case review.

followup.window: 18 months after radiotherapy, then at least 5 years
followup.note: Each participant is on study for about 20 months, including about 2 months of radiotherapy and 18 months of follow-up. After that, follow-up continues at the treating institution for at least 5 years according to French practice and REFCOR recommendations. Severe toxicity is assessed at 3 and 12 months.

eligibility: Nodepositive men were eligible if fewer than three positive nodes were resected during prostatectomy and no lymph nodes >2 cm were noted on screening imaging.
Inclusion criteria also included age /C2118 yr, Karnofsky performance status /C2170, and adequate renal, hepatic, and hematologic parameters.

Additional exclusion criteria included prior pelvic radiation, hormonal therapy, chemotherapy, immunotherapy, history of seizure or condition predisposing to seizure, and inability to absorb oral medications.
